description: This file implements the Pattern class and PatternList class for matching filename patterns with limited regex-like syntax, including pattern parsing, matching logic, and pattern list management.

classes.name: Pattern
classes.description: Represents a filename pattern with limited regex features, capable of matching strings based on parsed subranges.

classes.name: PatternList
classes.description: A collection of Pattern objects, providing methods to match strings or values against multiple patterns.

methods.name: Pattern(const std::string& s)
methods.description: Constructor that parses the pattern string into subranges.

methods.name: MatchesString(const std::string& s) const
methods.description: Checks if the given string matches the pattern.

methods.name: RecursiveMatch(const std::string& s, size_t begin_char, size_t subrange_index, bool allow_implicit_path_boundary) const
methods.description: Recursively matches string segments against pattern subranges.

methods.name: SetFromValue(const Value& v, Err* err)
methods.description: Initializes pattern list from a Value object representing a list of pattern strings.

methods.name: MatchesString(const std::string& s) const
methods.description: Checks if any pattern in the list matches the string.
